item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 11/Jun/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The area of low pressure near Leizhou Peninsula and the trough of low pressure over the coast of southern China will continue to bring showers and thunderstorms to the regions today. The area of low pressure is expected to move across the coast of western Guangdong and its adjacent waters on Monday and Tuesday, and may edge closer to the vicinity of the Pearl River Estuary. There will be heavy showers and squally thunderstorms over the region by then. An active southwest monsoon will continue to bring unsettled weather to the coast of Guangdong in the latter part of this week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Guchol will move towards the seas south of Japan in the next couple of days.
